items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we became good friends. As a matter of fact, Illinois, Joe Newman, and myself we became the unholy three.

ctx.x: Oh, Illinois. When Illinois came from Texas, man, from Houston, you know, he came in -- I think he came to one of our rehearsals. A saxophone player by the name of

Eddie Taylor who was from Houston also and knew Illinois brought him to the rehearsal. And Illinois was playing alto then, he wasn’t playing tenor. And he took his horn out and he played something on his horn man, it just made everybody flip. Jack Kelso, Buddy, damn who’s this -- you know, and we became good friends. As a matter of fact, Illinois, Joe Newman, and myself we became the unholy three. As a mater of fact just before I got engaged to my wife, we were all hanging out. We would always hang out together…
